fields.description: The client's contract number, e.g. TR201/CCP/P155759/2024/2025/W/02. Filled from the Tender No.; change it before saving if the client issued a different number. It becomes the name of this contract; to correct it later, use Rename.
fields.label: Contract No.

fields.description: The awarded tender this contract comes from.
fields.label: Tender

fields.description: The project this work is for.
fields.label: Project

fields.description: Main Contract: our agreement with the client. Subcontract: an agreement where we hire another company to do part of the work.
fields.label: Contract Type

fields.description: For a subcontract only: the main client contract this work falls under.
fields.label: Parent Main Contract

fields.description: Store on site for this contract's materials. Created automatically on submit if empty.
fields.label: Site Store

fields.description: The client who pays us for this work.
fields.label: Client (Customer)

fields.description: The company we hire to do part of the work (subcontracts only).
fields.label: Subcontractor (Supplier)

fields.description: From the BOQ: the bid price without VAT when the BOQ has a tender summary, otherwise the total of bills.
fields.label: Contract Amount

fields.description: Extra money set aside for unexpected costs, such as hidden rock during digging or price increases. Usually 5–10% of the contract amount.
fields.label: Contingency (%)

fields.description: Calculated automatically: Contract Amount × Contingency %.
fields.label: Contingency Amount

fields.description: The full budget for this contract: Contract Amount + Contingency Amount.
fields.label: Total Contract Value

fields.description: The Bill of Quantities (the list of work items, quantities and prices) this contract is based on.
fields.label: Linked BOQ

fields.description: Commencement date (site possession). Can be set once on a submitted contract; after that, change the time with an Extension of Time.
fields.label: Start Date

fields.description: Can be set once on a submitted contract; after that, change the time with an Extension of Time.
fields.label: Original Completion Date

fields.description: Total days approved on Extension of Time documents (Create > Extension of Time).
fields.label: Approved Extension (Days)

fields.description: Original completion + approved extensions of time.
fields.label: Revised Completion Date

fields.description: Fill when the works are completed (e.g. taking-over certificate).
fields.label: Actual Completion Date

fields.description: Documents the contractor must hand in before or during the work, such as insurance, performance security and work programme.
fields.label: Submittals
Payment Terms
fields.description: How each payment certificate is worked out comes from the Certificate Template (retention, advance recovery, VAT, releases...).

fields.label: Advance Payment (%)
fields.description: Of the Total Contract Value. Fills the Advance Payment Amount.

fields.label: Guarantee Expiry Date
fields.description: A reminder is sent 30 days before expiry.

fields.label: Liquidated Damages per Day
fields.description: Used to suggest Liquidated Damages on certificates for periods after the revised completion date.

fields.label: Balances to Date
fields.description: Updated when Progress Claims are submitted or cancelled.

fields.label: Certificate Template
fields.description: The client's rules, e.g. Ministry of Water (SEUWASA) or TANROADS. Used by every Progress Claim of this contract.

fields.label: Contract Sum (incl. VAT)
fields.description: The BOQ bid price, as on the Form of Tender.

fields.label: Payment Currencies
fields.description: Only when the client pays in more than one currency, e.g. 15% TZS and 85% USD. The certificate shows the amount due in each.

fields.label: Measurement Tolerance (%)
fields.description: How far a BOQ line may be measured above its revised quantity before a Variation Order is needed. 0 = not at all.
